verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments API platform, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoints, such as bulk refunds, bulk payment creation or bulk cancellation, and no bulk actions in the web app or MCP server. Split payments distribute funds within a single transaction, and subscriptions automate recurring charges on a schedule. Both are different capabilities and do not count as bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
